logic/glossary.entries.box.body.2.en: When the box yields \(A\to B\), its temporary assumption is discharged. The conclusion no longer depends on it, but other premises and outer assumptions remain. logic/glossary.entries.box.body.2.zh: 输出 \(A\to B\) 时，本框的临时假设被解除：结论不再依赖它，但其他前提和外层假设仍然保留。目标不能依赖未解除的临时假设。折叠框只是改变显示，不会解除假设。
